arguments.command: set -eu; W=/home/storage/781/4477781/user/webapp; echo '--- run-ollama.sh ---'; sed -n '1,260p' "$W/run-ollama.sh"; echo '--- ollama-runtime.env (OLLAMA only) ---'; grep -E '^OLLAMA_[A-Z0-9_]+=' "$W/ollama-runtime.env" | sort || true; echo '--- keepalive state names ---'; if [ -d "$W/.ollama-keepalive" ]; then find "$W/.ollama-keepalive" -maxdepth 2 -type f -printf '%P\n' | sort | head -100; fi; echo '--- ollama profiles ---'; if [ -d "$W/ollama-profiles" ]; then find "$W/ollama-profiles" -maxdepth 2 -type f -printf '%P\n' | sort | head -100; fi
